entries.title: Psalms 140:3
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Tongues - Using words as sharp and piercing as the sting of a serpent.

entries.title: Psalms 140:9
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Mischief - The mischief which they design against me, shall fall upon themselves.

entries.title: Psalms 140:10
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Coals - Divine vengeance, which is compared to coals of fire.

entries.title: Psalms 140:13–141:3
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Dwell - Shall constantly enjoy thy gracious and powerful presence.
